task.label: behavior & 1
task.history: all realshow exposures strictly before the complete user/timestamp block
task.timestamp_unit: milliseconds in prepared arrays; seconds for model time deltas
task.primary_metric: ROC_AUC over all eligible exposure targets, including hashed OOV
task.training_unit: one request prefix shared by all its independent candidate queries
task.empty_history: exclude request from supervised scoring; keep its exposures as later history
task.duplicate_exposure_rows: retain the prepared realshow rows; no target-level deduplication
task.feedback_availability_assumption: completed earlier-request feedback is available at the next strictly later timestamp

population.test_population: all 3210 initial final-role users; score all eligible targets without a minimum-history or outcome filter

catalog.selection: descending number of eligible D1-18 development exposure targets, ties by ascending raw video ID
catalog.known_ids: 1..K in ascending raw video ID after top-K selection
catalog.unknown_target_policy: keep target and both feedback labels; use its stable hash embedding
catalog.cold_item_identity_note: hash buckets share parameters and do not give each unseen video an independent embedding
catalog.directory_nesting: Large known videos are a subset of Max known videos; OOV IDs are stable within each model chain

training.precision: BF16 compute, FP32 master parameters/gradient/Adam moments; FP32 evaluation
training.optimizer_lineage: inherit model and AdamW through V0-V5; reset only per-release learning rate
training.execution: Large and Max V0-V5 request-grouped runners prepared on g202 two A40s, Large then Max; formal launch waiting. Active run configuration: experiments/foundation_recflow/configs/chain_large_max_2gpu_202.json
training.saved_endpoints: user update: retain every epoch as a complete model/AdamW/RNG checkpoint; all versions default to two epochs
training.bounded_loss_resume: 202 runner saves hourly rolling recovery (two generations), plus every permanent epoch checkpoint

estimate_scope.data_statistics: CPU counts from retained arrays, not model quality evaluation
estimate_scope.parameter_counts: CPU meta-model counts cross-checked against Yambda checkpoint tensor shapes
estimate_scope.timing: Two-A40 full six-version measured-input profiles are recorded in experiments/foundation_recflow/planning_chain_two_gpu.json. Max uses micro20 with two accumulated microbatches; historical conditional four-A40 fields are not the active ETA.
